verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents SSH-based secure file transfer to/from instances and a CLI workflow that includes 'copy data' as a step, plus persistent Volumes for data that survives instance destruction. However there is no evidence of S3-compatible endpoints or native cloud-storage (S3/GCS/Azure Blob) sync tooling, and a community comment notes persistent-disk workflows are still cumbersome over time. Missing for 10: S3-compatible storage endpoint, built-in cloud-storage sync/mirroring tooling, independent hands-on validation of transfer throughput/performance.
